description: Detect the ecommerce platform, payment providers and catalogue size behind a storefront.

tool_signatures.name: profile_ecommerce_platform
tool_signatures.description: Detect which ecommerce platform a storefront runs on (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce, Squarespace, Wix, PrestaShop or commercetools), plus its payment providers, subscription and marketplace apps, an estimated catalogue size, currencies and shipping destinations. Returns one flat Clay ready row. Static homepage and sitemap reads only, no browser, so a storefront that reveals its platform only after JavaScript runs is reported as not_extractable rather than labelled with the nearest guess. Confidence follows the KIND of evidence: a vendor header is high, a substring in the HTML is low. Use it to qualify ecommerce accounts by platform before outreach, or to segment a store list by catalogue size and payment stack. Pass company_name with the domain to cut wrong matches. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.
